prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='rf', seasonality_champion='rf', recommended_method='stl_hierarchical_stacking'. Narrative: rf dominates as both trend champion (1.0 correlation) and seasonality champion (0.5549 correlation), achieving the lowest overall RMSE of 68.69. However, the extremely high RMSE spread ratio (11.65) and significant seasonality variance indicate substantial model disagreement, making STL-hierarchical stacking ideal to exploit decomposition structure while handling heterogeneity. Early horizon specialist FT_rf (35.29 RMSE) differs from late specialist DWT_catboost (67.05 RMSE), suggesting per-horizon optimization within the stacking framework would further improve performance.
